properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Sunday, July 2, [1933]; includes description of final negotiations with the minister of communications [Chu Chia-hua] and upcoming trip to Canton [Guangzhou] with [William] Grooch and [Robert] Gast as pilots, radio operator William Ehmer, [William L.] Bond, [Paul] Groeger, and Mr. Wong; mentions Mimi Chu, Dai [Enki].
